name: VRISHTI AI Conversation Intelligence v2
purpose: Improve weather intent detection, location/date extraction, contextual follow-ups, safety routing, and verification routing for Goa, Karnataka and Kerala.
critical_rules: Use the full query plus conversation context to determine intent.
Never default state to Karnataka or district to Manual unless explicitly selected or correctly inherited.
Keep semantic intent separate from the UI sector.
Treat flood, flooding, waterlogging, landslide, driving, travel, farming and construction as weather-domain requests when they are conditioned on rainfall/weather.
Resolve today, now, tonight, tomorrow, day after tomorrow, next 3 days and this week.
Follow-up questions inherit the previous valid location, date, topic and station unless the user changes them.
Never fabricate forecast, probability or verification values.
If data is unavailable, report the exact data/service problem instead of changing the user's intent.

CURRENT_WEATHER: what is the weather in Bengaluru today
how is the weather in Bengaluru Urban today
what's the weather in Panaji right now
is it raining in Mangaluru now
what are the current conditions in Wayanad
WEATHER_FORECAST: what will the weather be tomorrow in Bengaluru
forecast for Panaji for the next 3 days
how will the weather be this weekend in Kerala

will it rain tomorrow in Kochi
rain forecast for the next 24 hours
RAIN_PROBABILITY: what is the chance of rain in Bengaluru today
probability of rainfall in Panaji tomorrow
what are the chances of rain in Kochi
HEAVY_RAIN_ALERT: is heavy rain expected in Panaji today
will there be extreme rainfall in Kerala
is there a heavy rain warning for Mangaluru
is intense rain expected in Wayanad
FLOOD_RISK: is there flood risk in Panaji today
is there flooding in Panaji today
will heavy rain cause flooding in Mangaluru
THUNDERSTORM_LIGHTNING: will there be thunderstorms in Bengaluru tonight
any thunderstorm risk in Kerala tomorrow
WIND_CONDITIONS: how strong will the winds be tomorrow in Panaji
are strong winds expected in Kerala
TEMPERATURE: what is the temperature in Bengaluru today
how hot will it be in Panaji tomorrow
HUMIDITY: what is the humidity in Bengaluru
AGRICULTURE_WEATHER: is the weather suitable for farming tomorrow
will rain affect crops in Kerala
is there a dry window for harvesting
CONSTRUCTION_WEATHER_SAFETY: is tomorrow suitable for construction work in Bengaluru
will rain affect construction in Panaji
will strong winds affect crane operations
HILL_TRAVEL_SAFETY: is it safe to travel to Wayanad tomorrow because of rain
will heavy rain affect hill travel in Kerala
is the road to Munnar dangerous due to rain
HIGHWAY_DRIVING_WEATHER: is it safe to drive on the highway tomorrow in Karnataka
will rain reduce visibility on the road

CITY_DRAINAGE_RAINFALL: will there be waterlogging in Bengaluru today

WEATHER_REGIME: is this an active monsoon or break period
what is the current rainfall regime

DISTRICT_FORECAST: give me district level rainfall for Karnataka
forecast rainfall by district in Kerala
which districts are expected to receive heavy rain
GRID_FORECAST: show the rainfall grid for Karnataka
MODEL_VERIFICATION: what is the FAR for Kerala
show CSI POD FAR and FSS
compare corrected rainfall with ground truth
MODEL_COMPARISON: is corrected forecast closer to observations
compare model performance before and after bias correction
NON_WEATHER: what is the capital of France

known_failures_to_prevent: "how is the weather in bengaluru urban today?" must not become ERROR
"is there floods in panaji today?" must not become NON_WEATHER
Do not assign Karnataka when no Karnataka location is present.
Do not assign Manual when a known city/district can be resolved.
Do not let the selected sector override semantic intent.
Do not lose context on follow-up questions.
